title: Chili Crisp Chicken Bowls
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Toss the cubed chicken with a pinch of salt and set aside.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet for 6 minutes until browned.
Add garlic and broccoli, cook 4 minutes until bright green.
Stir in chili crisp, soy sauce, and honey. Toss to coat.
Spoon over rice and finish with sliced scallions.
image_subject: Glossy cubes of seared chicken and bright broccoli over jasmine rice in a shallow bowl, chili crisp pooling at the edge, scallions scattered on top.
